findings.title: No explicit font-display strategy in main fonts
findings.description: While next/font includes display: "swap", individual page fonts may override.
findings.evidence: Fraunces and Inter configured with display: "swap" but this should be enforced site-wide.

findings.title: Service Worker cache strategy not optimized for SPA hydration
findings.description: SW.js exists but may not properly cache dynamic routes and API responses.
findings.evidence: Service Worker registered in layout.tsx but no stale-while-revalidate strategy visible in public/sw.js

findings.title: Missing HTTP/2 Server Push hints
findings.description: No Link headers configured for preload/prefetch optimization.
findings.evidence: next.config.ts has prefetch but no Link: <...>; rel=preload headers in async headers() function

findings.title: Image optimization may not cover all routes
findings.description: Images configured for AVIF/WebP but no explicit srcset fallback chains.
findings.evidence: next.config.ts images.formats only specifies modern formats; no jpeg fallback strategy documented

findings.title: API route caching set to must-revalidate
findings.description: API endpoints not cached, causes unnecessary revalidation overhead.
findings.evidence: Cache-Control header: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate for /api/* routes

findings.title: No manifest.json for offline PWA support
findings.description: Service Worker exists but no Web App Manifest for installability.
findings.evidence: No manifest.json or web.manifest in public/ directory

findings.title: Global CSS not minified at build time
findings.description: globals.css is 34KB; minification would reduce FCP/LCP.
findings.evidence: app/globals.css is 34,988 bytes with visible whitespace and comments

findings.title: No Brotli compression strategy defined
findings.description: Missing explicit compression preference; relies on default gzip.
findings.evidence: No compression headers in next.config.ts or vercel.json

findings.title: No explicit viewport meta tag in layout.tsx
findings.description: Viewport tag missing; mobile scaling may be incorrect at 375px.
findings.evidence: layout.tsx does not include <meta name="viewport" content="..."/> in head

findings.title: Tailwind breakpoints may not cover small mobile (320px)
findings.description: Min breakpoint likely sm: 640px; no 375px or 320px test coverage mentioned.
findings.evidence: No explicit 375px mobile audit in mobile-ux-optimization reports

findings.title: Touch target sizes not explicitly enforced
findings.description: Buttons and interactive elements may fall below 48px × 48px mobile target.
findings.evidence: No documented touch-target-size audit or component constraint

findings.title: Micro-interactions CSS may cause jank on low-end mobile
findings.description: micro-interactions.css (12KB+) with transitions; no reduced-motion media query.
findings.evidence: micro-interactions-enhanced.css includes animations without @media (prefers-reduced-motion)

findings.title: No explicit mobile typography scale
findings.description: Type scale from display/h1/h2 may be too large on 375px viewport.
findings.evidence: No separate typography scale for mobile in responsive design audit

findings.title: Form inputs may have autofill styling issues
findings.description: No explicit webkit-autofill styling; mobile browser autofill may override.
findings.evidence: No -webkit-autofill color overrides in globals.css or component styles

findings.title: No sitemap.xml or sitemap.ts generated
findings.description: Search engines cannot discover all pages without XML sitemap.
findings.evidence: No sitemap.xml, sitemap.ts, or sitemap route handler in app/ directory

findings.title: No robots.txt file exists
findings.description: robots.txt missing; crawlers guess rules and may block important pages.
findings.evidence: No robots.txt in public/ or app/ directory

findings.title: Dynamic routes not statically exported
findings.description: Specialty pages (adhd, perinatal, etc.) not registered for sitemap generation.
findings.evidence: 33 page routes exist but no site map generation logic discovered

findings.title: No canonical URL metadata on pages
findings.description: Pages lack explicit canonical links; duplicates may be indexed.
findings.evidence: Metadata objects in page.tsx files do not include canonical URL

findings.title: Sitemap locale variants not declared
findings.description: If serving non-English, no hreflang tags or sitemap locale attributes.
findings.evidence: Only EN (English) content; no alternate language versions or hreflang tags

findings.title: Missing robots.txt allows all crawlers by default
findings.description: No robots.txt means crawlers assume all content is crawlable; sensitive routes may be indexed.
findings.evidence: File not found: public/robots.txt or app/robots.ts

findings.title: No sitemap reference in robots.txt
findings.description: Cannot declare sitemap location without robots.txt.
findings.evidence: robots.txt does not exist to include Sitemap: https://...

findings.title: API routes not disallowed
findings.description: No directive to block crawlers from /api/* routes.
findings.evidence: No robots.txt rule: Disallow: /api/

findings.title: Admin/internal routes not blocked
findings.description: No rules for internal routes (e.g., /.next, /admin, if they exist).
findings.evidence: No robots.txt Disallow rules for internal or development routes

findings.title: No explicit canonical URL in Metadata objects
findings.description: Pages lack canonical links; query params and trailing slashes create duplicates.
findings.evidence: Metadata in app/adhd/page.tsx, app/about/page.tsx lack canonical field

findings.title: Redirect from /resources to /guides not declared with rel-canonical
findings.description: Permanent redirect exists but canonical not set on target /guides.
findings.evidence: next.config.ts redirects: /resources → /guides (permanent: true) but /guides has no canonical

findings.title: Query string parameters not canonicalized
findings.description: Pages may be accessed with duplicate query params; no canonical handling.
findings.evidence: No logic to strip or normalize query strings (e.g., ?utm_source, ?ref)

findings.title: Trailing slash inconsistency not addressed
findings.description: No explicit rule for /adhd vs /adhd/; Next.js 16 behavior may vary.
findings.evidence: No next.config.ts trailingSlash setting; defaults may create duplicates

findings.title: No HSTS header configured
findings.description: Strict-Transport-Security header missing; browsers may not enforce HTTPS.
findings.evidence: No HSTS header in next.config.ts headers() function

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header
findings.description: CSP missing; XSS and injection attacks not mitigated.
findings.evidence: No CSP header in next.config.ts or vercel.json

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
findings.description: No protection against clickjacking; X-Frame-Options not set.
findings.evidence: No X-Frame-Options in headers configuration

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.description: Browser MIME-sniffing not disabled; potential security risk.
findings.evidence: No X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff in headers

findings.title: Referrer-Policy not explicitly set
findings.description: Default referrer policy may leak query params to external links.
findings.evidence: No Referrer-Policy header configured

findings.title: /resources → /guides permanent redirect (single hop)
findings.description: One known redirect; chain is single hop (acceptable).
findings.evidence: next.config.ts: { source: "/resources", destination: "/guides", permanent: true }

findings.title: No redirect audit for moved/renamed specialty pages
findings.description: If specialty pages were renamed, old URLs may 404 instead of redirecting.
findings.evidence: No documented redirect map for renamed pages (e.g., old specialty slugs)

findings.title: No redirect for www vs non-www normalization
findings.description: If domain supports both www and non-www, no explicit 301 redirect.
findings.evidence: No www redirect rule in next.config.ts

findings.title: No redirect for HTTP to HTTPS (relying on hosting)
findings.description: Assuming hosting enforces HTTPS; no app-level redirect.
findings.evidence: No redirect logic in next.config.ts for HTTP → HTTPS

findings.title: LocalBusinessSchema may lack required properties
findings.description: Schema missing areaServed, telephone, or address details.
findings.evidence: lib/schema.ts getLocalBusinessSchema() not verified for completeness

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList schema for navigation
findings.description: Breadcrumb trails not marked up for SERP rich snippets.
findings.evidence: No BreadcrumbList schema in page templates or layout

findings.title: No FAQSchema for FAQ pages
findings.description: FAQ pages (adhd-faq, perinatal-faq) lack FAQPage schema.
findings.evidence: FAQ page templates do not include schema FAQPage or Question markup

findings.title: Missing Article schema for blog/guide content
findings.description: If guides are articles, Article schema not applied.
findings.evidence: app/guides content lacks datePublished, author, schema context

findings.title: No AggregateRating schema for testimonials
findings.description: Testimonial cards not marked up with AggregateRating.
findings.evidence: TestimonialCard component missing schema markup for ratingValue/reviewCount

findings.title: Schema.org @context not declared on all JSON-LD blocks
findings.description: Missing @context: "https://schema.org" on some schema objects.
findings.evidence: lib/schema.ts may not include @context in all returned schemas

findings.title: No TestimonialSchema or Review schema for testimonials
findings.description: Testimonials lack Review or Testimonial schema markup.
findings.evidence: Testimonials rendered as plain text; no schema structured data
